geometryValidationSql.polygon|default:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT s.source_key, ST_GeomFromGeoJSON(g.geojson) AS geom
    FROM unnest($1::BIGINT[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS s(source_key, ord)
    JOIN unnest($2::TEXT[])   WITH ORDINALITY AS g(geojson, ord)   ON s.ord = g.ord
),
validated AS (
  SELECT
    source_key,
    ST_GeometryType(repaired) AS repaired_type,
    ST_Multi(COALESCE(ST_CollectionExtract(repaired, 3), repaired)) AS geom_final,
    is_valid_original
  FROM (
    SELECT source_key,
           ST_IsValid(geom)   AS is_valid_original,
           ST_MakeValid(geom) AS repaired
      FROM input
  ) s
)
SELECT source_key,
       CASE
         WHEN ST_GeometryType(geom_final) IN ('ST_Polygon','ST_MultiPolygon')
              AND NOT ST_IsEmpty(geom_final)
              AND repaired_type = 'ST_GeometryCollection'                       THEN 'collection_extracted'
         WHEN ST_GeometryType(geom_final) IN ('ST_Polygon','ST_MultiPolygon')
              AND NOT ST_IsEmpty(geom_final)                                     THEN 'accepted'
         WHEN geom_final IS NULL OR ST_IsEmpty(geom_final)                       THEN 'skipped_null'
         ELSE 'skipped_unsupported_type'
       END AS status,
       ST_AsBinary(geom_final) AS geom_wkb,
       is_valid_original
  FROM validated;

ingestor_validation_sql.massing|building_footprints:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT s.source_key, ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromGeoJSON(g.geojson), 3857), 4326) AS geom
    FROM unnest($1::TEXT[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS s(source_key, ord)
    JOIN unnest($2::TEXT[])   WITH ORDINALITY AS g(geojson, ord)   ON s.ord = g.ord
),
validated AS (
  SELECT
    source_key,
    ST_GeometryType(repaired) AS repaired_type,
    repaired AS geom_final,
    is_valid_original,
    footprint_area_sqm,
    footprint_area_sqft
  FROM (
    SELECT source_key,
           ST_IsValid(geom)   AS is_valid_original,
           geom AS repaired,
           ROUND((ST_Area(geom::geography))::numeric, 2) AS footprint_area_sqm,
           ROUND((ST_Area(geom::geography) * 10.7639104167)::numeric, 2) AS footprint_area_sqft
      FROM input
  ) s
)
SELECT source_key,
       CASE
         WHEN ST_GeometryType(geom_final) IN ('ST_Polygon','ST_MultiPolygon')
              AND NOT ST_IsEmpty(geom_final)
              AND repaired_type = 'ST_GeometryCollection'                       THEN 'collection_extracted'
         WHEN ST_GeometryType(geom_final) IN ('ST_Polygon','ST_MultiPolygon')
              AND NOT ST_IsEmpty(geom_final)                                     THEN 'accepted'
         WHEN geom_final IS NULL OR ST_IsEmpty(geom_final)                       THEN 'skipped_null'
         ELSE 'skipped_unsupported_type'
       END AS status,
       ST_AsBinary(geom_final) AS geom_wkb,
       is_valid_original,
       footprint_area_sqm,
       footprint_area_sqft
  FROM validated;
